tasks.replacement_reason: Replace the generic-tutorial shortcut with another-kitchen purchasing and a later top-material preference. Existing cart actions suffice; old formal member remains unchanged pending independent review and authorized trial.

original_annotations: On amazon.com, find a product page for a stovetop from the exact brand shown on the stovetop in the video, with the same number of burners. Open a listing whose title or specifications clearly show that brand and burner count.

observed_events.description: A tabletop gas stove carries three separate pan-support/burner positions: a large open pot at front left, a pressure cooker behind it, and a small saucepan at front right. Later in this same interval the front logo reads Preethi. Burner count is not inferred merely from the three control knobs.

unsupported_claims: Exact stove model, installation dimensions, gas supply type and suitability for moving while connected are not established.

screening.instruction_provenance: Another-kitchen purchase and later stainless-steel preference are authored user intentions, not recorded speech or a safety conclusion.
screening.source_review: Constructor inspected all 210 consecutive decoded frames from [23,30) at the source 30 fps and original 480x360 resolution, tiled without scaling into seven 5x6 sheets interval-full_01.png through interval-full_07.png in .scratch/scene-repair-20261017/stove-native, plus the 30-second endpoint and all eight released frames. The 180-second source outside this relevant interval was only sampled at 15-second intervals in prior context, not fully played. Wide burner positions and later brand marking are both published.

supported_claims.text: The source tabletop stove is Preethi and has three distinct burner/pan-support positions.

unsupported_claims: No exact model, dimension or fuel compatibility is required or inferred.
Stainless steel is an expressed user preference, not a claimed safety advantage.

construct.research_question: Can the Agent preserve visually identified brand and burner count while narrowing the same purchase by top material?
construct.belief_before: One tabletop Preethi gas stove with three burners; no exact model, colour, layout, ignition or material restriction.
construct.belief_after: The same brand and three burners, with a stainless-steel top rather than glass.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace a glass-top selection if necessary; retain either matching stainless-steel selection.
construct.no_update_failure: Leave a matching three-burner glass-top stove after the stainless-steel preference.
construct.overupdate_failure: Lose the scene-derived brand or burner count while changing material.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: Neither instruction names the brand or burner count. The full window contains stainless-steel two-, three- and four-burner stoves from several brands; no single listing satisfies all reasonable scene identities.

observed.why: The new top-material preference narrows the same single-stove purchase, preserving the visual brand and burner count.

answer_boundary_review.scope: Complete first pages of both natural queries, including product-bearing sponsored placements; 89 distinct entities. All titles read. Six Preethi three-burner listings retained for A; two stainless-steel variants for B. Manufacturer image resolves Glamsteel count conflict without deleting the native conflicting field.
